name: yf_splits
description:
Stock split history for one ticker from Yahoo Finance (yfinance splits).
Returns: {symbol, data_points (all rows), truncated, splits: the most recent limit rows, oldest first, each {Date, Stock Splits (ratio as a number, e.g. 4.0 for 4-for-1)}}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T); limit (rows, 1-1000; default 100).
Dividends and splits together: yf_actions; dividends only: yf_dividends.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "limit": 20}
